concepts.gloss_en: The totality/collective of the sinews (the aggregate of the bodily channels, associated with ruach and tzedakah)
The blemish/flaw of the collective of the sinews (a defective state, equated with flaw of the garments and flaw of the covenant) — a defect ABOUT the sinews, not the sinews themselves

members.note: representative; distinct construct head (פגם) — a state/defect about the sinews, not the concept itself (rule 4)

notes: Token overlap only. פגם כלליות הגידין is a blemish/action-state predicated on כלליות הגידין; per rule 4 these are different concepts. Kept separate.
